events.text: First C set entered service from Mortdale Maintenance Depot

evidence.quote: The first set entered service in July 1986

events.text: All sets operating from Punchbowl depot as sets K40-K51

evidence.quote: by December 1988 , all were operating out of Punchbowl Maintenance Depot as sets K40-K51

events.text: Chopper cars retargeted as sets C42-C54

evidence.quote: By December 1990 , they had been retargeted as C42-C54

events.text: Cars reformed as 6-car sets numbered C1-C8

evidence.quote: In January 1991 , these were reformed as 6-car sets numbered C1-C8

events.text: All sets transferred to Hornsby Maintenance Depot

evidence.quote: By June 1991 , all had been transferred to Hornsby Maintenance Depot
In 2001 , the C sets were once again reformed into seven 8-car sets

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: All C sets withdrawn for inspection after asbestos found in circuit breaker panels

evidence.quote: In July 2017 , asbestos was found in the circuit breaker panels

events.text: All C sets begin operating out of Flemington Maintenance Depot

evidence.quote: Since November 2017 , all C Sets operated out of Flemington Maintenance Depot

events.label: phase-out
events.text: Gradual phase-out of C sets begins, replaced by B sets

evidence.quote: gradually phased out from September 2020 to February 2021

events.label: phase-out
events.text: Gradual phase-out of C sets ends, replaced by B sets

evidence.quote: gradually phased out from September 2020 to February 2021

events.label: final service
events.text: C sets run final revenue timetabled service on Airport & South Line

evidence.quote: The C sets ran their final revenue timetabled service on 26 February 2021

events.label: farewell tour
events.text: C sets farewell tour takes place

evidence.quote: A farewell tour took place on 6 March 2021

undated_mentions: During the late 1990s, all C sets were refurbished by A Goninan & Co as part of the CityDecker program
